source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Strategies for Effective Collaboration (PDF 130, printed 126).

blocks.text: Mo-assar collaboration teams ko aasani se kaam karne aur kaam kamyabi se mukammal karne mein madad deta hai. Jab har koi apni zimmedariyan samajhta hai aur wazeh baat karta hai to teamwork mazboot hota hai. Planning, kaam munazzam karna aur khayalat share karna group projects ko bina uljhan aage barhate hain. Collaboration yeh bhi sikhata hai ke mukhtalif raye ka ehtram kaise karein aur ek mushtarka maqsad ki taraf kaise kaam karein. Neeche mo-assar collaboration ki aam strategies (tadabeer) hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Wazeh roles (kirdar), kaam ka intezam aur goals tay karna teamwork ki karkardagi barhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Kitab ke mutabiq teamwork kab mazboot hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab har member apni zimmedari samjhe aur wazeh baat kare; planning, organizing aur ideas share karne se project bina confusion aage barhta hai.

items: Effective collaboration: zimmedari, wazeh communication, planning.
